timezone: Asia/Shanghai with explicit UTC offset in serialized timestamps

classes.PRE_OPEN_KNOWN: Effective-dated trading calendar and daily reference/limit/trading constraint published before session; use only after final available pre-open version is known.
classes.INTRADAY_OBSERVED: Price/volume observations usable no earlier than their observation timestamp.
classes.EOD_FINALIZED: Raw unadjusted daily OHLCV and amount usable only at or after actual session close/bar finalization, never at midnight trade-date marker.
classes.DERIVED_EOD: RSI14, MA5 and 5-day limit count availability is max of all source-input available_at timestamps; no calculations implemented here.

causal_guard: timezone-aware decision_at >= available_at; future trade-date and premature same-day EOD rejected; unknown source publication semantics rejected
raw_market_data_pit: EVENT_TIME_SAFE if historical trade_date, no future-derived labels, EOD cutoff enforcement and frozen retrieval snapshot; provider first-write and complete revision ledger not required for raw bars
snapshot_policy: On actual backtest acquisition freeze raw response and metadata, refer to content hash; re-pulls create a new immutable version and never silently overwrite the dataset used by an existing run.
revision_history: REVISION_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE is recorded, but not an independent Gate B blocker for OHLCV.
strict_publication_pit_source_admission: PROHIBITED_FOR_CAUSAL_BACKTEST until publication/version semantics are proven; outside present core causal set
same_close_execution: SAME_CLOSE_EXECUTION_REQUIRES_STAGE1_EXECUTION_POLICY: a final close/RSI/close-at-limit signal is known at or after close, so assuming fill at that same final close needs a separate closing-auction, next-session or pre-close snapshot execution policy. Not a Gate B blocker.
